faq.q: What is the origin of Canan?
faq.a: Canan is associated with Arabic. Canan is the Turkish form of Arabic جَنَان (Janān), associated with the senses 'beloved' and 'heart'.
Yes — the underlying form جَنَان is Arabic.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Canan, canan. Script forms are جنان, جَنَان, जानान.
